programs.showName: Deewaar: Let's Bring Our Heroes Home
programs.description: Haunted by the past, Vijay turns to crime, while Ravi, his younger brother, becomes an honest police officer. Fate pits them against each other when Ravi is sent to nab Vijay.

Amar sets out to avenge his father's death but gets beaten to the brink of death. He returns to carry on his vendetta, only to be confronted by Vicky, a criminal-turned-policeman and his close friend.
A casino owner is trapped by a gangster and forced to work for him. However, when he refuses to kill a commissioner, the gangster abducts his secretary and sister to blackmail him.
Subir, a singer, encourages his wife, Uma, to pursue a singing career. However, things take a turn when she becomes more popular than him.
Shanti and Suraj lead a content life until he abandons her to marry Ruchi. Shanti and Ruchi both give birth to boys, who grow up and fight each other, unaware that they are half-brothers.

Amit wants to marry a modern woman, but his parents get him married to a village girl, Madhuri. When Amit refuses to accept her as his wife, Madhuri reinvents herself as Malathi and re-enters his life.

The story revolves around two childhood friends, played by Himansh Kohli and Priya Banerjee, who go separate ways in pursuit of their respective dreams. When they return to their hometown and meet after a long separation, they understand that their relationship is more than just friendship.
A rich girl runs away from home and settles down with a truck driver. However, her dream life is shattered when she learns that her new lover has been accused of murder.
A wife embraces her husband's illegitimate son as her own in honour of the other woman's memory. However, as time progresses, this starts to seem like a big mistake.
Rahul falls in love with Sandhya, a fellow college student, but realises that she does not reciprocate his feelings. Undeterred by her rejection, he still pursues her but pays a huge price for it.
The parents of an adopted child face issues of love, betrayal and custody when their daughter's birth mother arrives.

A policeman and a reformed criminal go to Kenya to comprehend a syndicate leader. However, they must break the rules of the land defended by Surya Pratap, a Kenyan police inspector.

programs.showName: Rafoo Chakkar: Fun on the Run
programs.description: Two brothers, Manjeet and Parmeet, run away from their home in order to avoid getting married. Eventually, they lead a life of crime and things take a turn when they get arrested.
Jaswant is arrested and tortured for a crime he did not commit. On seeing his friend's condition, Kripal joins an extremist group in order to bring down the government.
Salman and Rukhsar's love brings two warring families face to face, only for tradition, dowry demands and heartbreak to test their fragile bond.
After the death of his parent, Kunal lives with his grandfather Shamsher. However, when he falls in love with Durga, Shamsher plans to separate them.
Gangaram brings up his stepbrothers and borrows money to educate them. But, when he fails to repay and faces legal trouble, his brothers strive to help him.
Army officer Vikram works with terrorist Kubla and steals vital army information for him. In the process, he ends up killing a colleague and pins the blame on a fellow soldier.
Manisha, a wealthy woman, falls in love with Ajay, a middle-class man, who promises to marry her and settle down within three years. However, after the time period passes, he mysteriously disappears.
Born out of wedlock, Vijay grows up with deep resentment towards his biological father Raj, a wealthy industrialist who has been leading a comfortable life with his legitimate family in the big city.
Abandoned by his parents, Kishan becomes an elusive robber and teams up with Mary. However, when she leaves him to pursue her grand plan, he decides to seek revenge from the man who ruined his life.

Sushma escapes from her arranged marriage and embarks on an adventure that changes her life forever. Along the way, she encounters several men, each embodying different aspects of human life.
Destiny separates two lovers, Inder and Rama, and Inder marries Kamala. However, events take an unprecedented turn when Inder and Rama cross paths again years later.
Vipul and Saurabh, two friends, decide to put an end to the misery of couples by starting a love hotel. However, the local political group is not in favour of their venture.
Jay Singh encounters Seema while struggling to seek justice for his deceased father. As the couple attempts to live a happy life, unforeseen circumstances invite more troubles.
Twin brothers Raja and Prem Malhotra get separated at birth but are reunited by fate to defeat Ratanlal, a local gangster, who wants to destroy the Malhotra family.
An aspiring screenwriter becomes involved in a diamond heist while writing a script for his film and struggles to evade the police.
Aslam, a villager who runs a small business, accidentally meets the Prime Minister of India, who grants him special security on his request. Soon, he starts chasing political ambitions.
Anwar, a Muslim boy, falls in love with a Hindu girl who rejects him and elopes with his best friend. Post her death, a misunderstanding leads the police to believe that he is a terrorist.
Raja, a taxi driver, falls in love with Aarti, a rich girl and marries her against her parents' wishes. Later, her stepmother tries to create differences between the couple.
Shaamu, who lives a carefree life, falls in love with a well-educated girl, Raadha. However, circumstances force the young couple to part ways.

Things turn awry when a businessman, unaware of the truth, allows his pampered daughter to get engaged to the son of his old rival.
Friends Vikas and Sunil, along with their girlfriends, Ayesha and Mamta, unknowingly become a part of an awful terrorist plot to kill a minister.
Ashok, a fraudster, pretends to be rich and cheats several people. However, things take a turn when he falls in love with Seema.
After his lookalike, Ranjith, convinces Bhola to impersonate him for money, an innocent Bhola soon finds himself in trouble when the police chase after him for Ranjith's crimes.

programs.showName: Love Ke Liye Kuch Bhi Karega
programs.description: Prakash plans to extort money from his distrusting father-in-law. Rahul and Harry, who are in desperate need of cash, join hands with Prakash and help kidnap his wife as part of the plan.
When Amba gets her son Rajendra arrested for sexually assaulting their servant's daughter, Rajendra's wife wreaks havoc in their lives as she vows to avenge him.
Mohanlal, a musician and a thief, robs rich people and distributes the money amongst the poor. However, things take a turn when he falls for Sunita, a wealthy man's daughter.
Twins Amit and Kishan are separated at birth. However, when their paths cross in the future, together they work their way through and strive to overcome challenges.
After Major Vijay Malhotra's colleagues betray him, he is branded as a traitor and subsequently killed. But his son, Vicky, vows to take revenge on his father's murderers and prove his innocence.
Rajveer, a police officer, is tasked with protecting a nine-year-old heir, Abbas. However, the job gets complicated when Nazir, a dangerous criminal, seeks to harm the child.

Police Inspector Kapil Khanna realises that his baby boy has been switched with a girl child by the hospital and files a lawsuit against the owner, Robert Decosta, while trying to find his missing son.
Karan Saxena, a police officer, arrests Sapna Mathur, a woman accused of killing his fellow constable. Things take a turn when Karan falls in love with her and helps her escape her death sentence.
Ajay, a businessman, provides funds to Sarjuprasad to develop his hometown. When he learns that the money has been misappropriated by Sarjuprasad, he resolves to set things right.
When Prakash's father dies, he is forced to shoulder the financial responsibilities of his large family. However, his troubles increase when his younger brother leaves him home to join a gang.
When an expelled police inspector, an outlaw and a commissioner's son are implicated by a dealer, they unite to seek revenge and prove they are not culprits.

Anuradha relocates to Mumbai where she meets Vivek, an aspiring politician, and marries him. Things take a turn when he is arrested for murder, and she has to take his place in the upcoming elections.
Jeet, a former judo champion, decides to travel to Canada in search of employment. However, since she has no money, she seeks the help of a local man who ends up cheating her.
Kishan, a dairy farmer, and Kabir, his brother, run into trouble when a local promoter decides to take over their land. When a corrupt inspector plays his part and kills Kabir, Kishan vows vengeance.
A policeman and a reformed criminal go to Kenya to comprehend a syndicate leader. However, they must break the rules of the land defended by Surya Pratap, a Kenyan police inspector.
Sitaram refuses to accept his son Vasudev's marriage to Suman. Years later, he eagerly awaits their return from the USA but is left disheartened when his granddaughter Sita turns up alone.

Raja, a good-for-nothing fortune hunter, sets his sights on the daughter of a wealthy businessman. Before long, love takes over and brings about a twist in the tale.
Avatar leads a happy life with his wife, Radha, and his sons, Chander and Ramesh. However, consumed by their greed and ambitions, Avatar's sons betray him, but he soon reaches new heights of success.
A widowed man and woman face abuse from their respective children and seek comfort from each other instead.
After his wife Rukmini is abducted by his cruel brother, Vishwam is forced to confront the deep-rooted issues of power and control that plague their village, leading to tragic consequences.
A factory worker's son needs a heart transplant, but the hospital will not go ahead with it without paying upfront. So, he is forced to take the law into his own hands to save his sick child.
Indian and Pakistani armies clash verbally, leading to a cricket match challenge where territorial pride hangs in the balance.

India 1982; Romance; Dir. Sai Paranjpye; Cast: Farooq Shaikh, Naseeruddin Shah, Deepti Naval. Rajaram, a middle-class clerk, is secretly in love with his neighbour, Sandhya, but is too shy to disclose his love. He is shocked when his smooth-talking friend comes visiting and soon woos Sandhya.
Frustrated with his wife, Namdev, a businessman, decides to end his life. However, things take a turn when he envisions his dead father who encourages him to rethink his decision.

programs.showName: I Proud to Be an Indian
programs.description: I, a man from India, travels to London for a family wedding and finds that their community is being threatened by a racist group. Seeing this, he decides to get involved and fight back.
When the wealthy Durgeshwari's daughter falls in love with Raja, a poor boy, she reluctantly agrees to their union. However, she constantly tries to sabotage their relationship, but Raja outwits her.

Brothers Prem, Vijay and Ravi are happy, but their lives change when Prem gets killed. Ravi must save his family from an evil man, Dharampal, while Vijay is preoccupied with Sapna.
After losing her ability to sing, Neha, a famous star, relocates to a small village. While she attempts to get back her voice, she encounters Rajesh, who decides to help her.
Sangeeta, a young woman, decides to sacrifice her dreams and work relentlessly to provide for her family after her father abandons them.
Three roommates decide to solve their financial struggles by going down the path of crime and kidnapping people for small ransoms.
Shaamu, who lives a carefree life, falls in love with a well-educated girl, Raadha. However, circumstances force the young couple to part ways.
When Amba Prasad realises the harsh truth that his relatives just care for his money, he leaves home. Upon reaching a village, he meets Arun and Aarti and his life changes forever.
A slum-dwelling performer finds a new calling as a rising disco star. However, things take an unfortunate turn when an enemy from the past reappears in his life.
Sahibjaan, a young courtesan, falls in love with Salim. The two wish to marry, but the nature of her profession keeps casting a dark shadow over their plans.
Sonam's night of celebration turns into a disaster when her car hits an innocent man. Afraid of being punished for the crime, she decides to hide him but invites trouble in turn.
A devout Muslim Indian man is tasked with repairing a lorry in order to transport the ashes of Mahatma Gandhi. However, when communal violence strikes, he is left with a troubling dilemma.
